label: negative
description: register() no longer checks user != address(0) itself; the check moved into _store(), which register() always calls unconditionally, and it runs there before the state write (registered[user] = true). The same parameter value is validated, just one call deep.
why_labeled: Exclusion 6.2: the check is enforced downstream in a function this one always calls, on the same value, before any state change. register() calls _store(user) unconditionally with the same user, and _store() requires user != address(0) before writing state, so every path that reaches the state change still passes the guard. No validation was lost - it relocated into the callee. Rule 6 MUST stay quiet.
